counts_for: R1 rounds only; R1 is judged on a later pre-registered confirmation evaluation, registered only if a round passes on all ten seeds
motivation: session 3 (README 'Walk session 3 closes at 0 of 10 over three runs' and 'Walk session 4: the diagnosis it starts from'): steel-ball feet passed W10 on every seed of rounds 9-10 (-0.021..-0.043 hip heights), but no round of session 3 took a step (worst foot 0 steps, W8-low 0.00, RR held up on all ten seeds of rounds 9 and 10); round 10's speed_track paid +1.0..+1.65/step against +0.25 at rest by rocking (tray v/command sd 0.47-0.84 around a median near zero). The agent's own closing turn diagnosed the concave speed reward as farmable and proposed a convex speed cost and progress-gated swing pay. Session 4 changes nothing in the rules: same mechanism bounds as session 3, same spec, same seeds, same trainer; three more runs

spec_block.mechanism_rule: byte-identical except the values of HIP_MM and WEIGHT_N, which must equal the evaluated model's rig.hip_height_mm and rig.weight_n as the evaluation report states them (to the block's printed precision); SPEC_LIFT keeps its formula

mechanism.agent_may_change: geometry, bodies, collision shapes and per-body contact settings, joints and limits, actuators, and the parameters that set them, through the ordinary edit and accept path
bounds: four legs on one free base; the spec's feet stay c_foot_fl, c_foot_fr, c_foot_rl, c_foot_rr
the floor body and its plane, and every global physics setting (timestep, gravity, solver), unchanged
actuators stay catalog parts at catalog limits
mechanism.actor_changes: none: the actor does not tune the reward, the spec or the mechanism; the prompt states session 3's measurements and points the agent at its own closing report

trainer.rule: ADR-465 and ADR-466, unchanged since session 2

driver_args: --max-runs 16 --max-turns 2: the driver counts stored evaluations, and the ledger holds 13 before this session (11 registrations, one a refused start; 13 evaluations), so 16 is three more; the prompts' own stop rule is three runs, and a refused start is not a run

per_run.seed_rule: the product agent chooses it at train_start; train_start refuses any of 1101-1110
per_run.registered_by: train_start writes runs/<run>/registration.json and a train_registered ledger row before launch

wall_clock_bound: 2 turns; at most 3 runs of at most 2400 s each (7,200 s GPU at most); one GPU job at a time (machine training lock)
stop_rule: an evaluation passes on every seed, or the session has trained and evaluated 3 runs, or 2 turns have ended
supervision: rounds.py under setsid, outliving the actor's session; each training run under its own cadex_cli.loop supervisor
after: after each evaluation: the spec block is compared under mechanism_rule; the model digest, hip height and weight are recorded; a difference voids that evaluation
